name: The Professor
description: A portable Skill-suite plugin — scan a target repo, draft and maintain its documentation library, and keep per-section provenance, pointed at any repo, not just one handbook. The seven skills are the distributable unit, installable into whatever agent already exists; the bundled persona is an optional companion, not a requirement. Build state, phase by phase (launchpad/Research/the-professor-skill-suite-redesign.md §9): Phase 0 is decided; Phase 1, the tools/professor.py tool layer, is built and hardened; all seven SKILL.md procedures are written; Phase 1b is filed as issue #2131 and has not been started; Phases 2-7 are not built.
